title: The woman left alone on an Arctic island with a cat
hook: A young mother was left alone on an Arctic island with only a cat.
summary: Ada Blackjack, hired as a seamstress for the 1921 Wrangel Island expedition, became its only survivor and was rescued in 1923 after teaching herself to hunt.
sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica / Wikipedia: Ada Blackjack - hired 1921 as seamstress for the Wrangel Island expedition, only survivor, rescued August 1923 by Harold Noice
Jennifer Niven, Ada Blackjack (2003); Smithsonian Magazine - three men left January 1923 and vanished, Lorne Knight died of scurvy, Ada survived with cat Vic

lines.text: She was left alone on an Arctic island with only a cat.
lines.caps: Left *alone | on an Arctic *island | with only a *cat

lines.text: In nineteen twenty-one, Ada Blackjack joined four men to claim Wrangel Island.
lines.caps: In *1921, | Ada joined *four men | to claim *Wrangel Island

lines.text: She took the job to pay for her son's medicine.
lines.caps: She took the *job | to *pay for her | *son's medicine

lines.text: Two years later, food ran short, and three men went for help.
lines.caps: Two years *later, | *food ran short, | three men went for *help

lines.text: They never returned. The fourth man, too ill to walk, died.
lines.caps: They *never returned. | The fourth man, *too ill | to walk, *died

lines.text: Ada taught herself to hunt, with a cat for company.
A ship finally came, and she was the only one to go home.
lines.caps: A *ship finally came, | she was the *only one | to go *home

post.caption:
Ada Blackjack took a job to pay for her son's medicine and ended up alone on an Arctic island.
Would you have survived alone out there?
Follow @unt.oldfiles for a new untold story every day.
